Very unprofessional for that big store if you want your customers come back then u should be flexible in all terms don't show your rudeness to customers after selling your item Allah don't like rude person and also told to give big hand if you are shopkeeper if you want barkat in your rizq.
I have kept all the lights in their store and moved out. Fear Allah for your tradings don't go for money always.

For every one don't buy from here emyas store if you want too many items for home renovation or building, one two pieces is OK buying from them.

EMI Shielding vs Magnetic Shielding: What's the Difference?

Many electronic failures are not caused by defective components—they are caused by interference.

While EMI Shielding and Magnetic Shielding are often considered the same, they protect against different types of interference:
✔ EMI Shielding protects against high-frequency electromagnetic radiation and radio frequency interference (RFI).
✔ Magnetic Shielding protects against low-frequency and static magnetic fields that can affect sensitive equipment and precision instruments.

Choosing the right shielding solution helps improve:
✅ Equipment reliability
✅ Signal integrity
✅ Operational efficiency
✅ System performance
✅ Long-term durability

DOMADIA™ supplies advanced shielding materials including MuMetal (UNS N14080), conductive fabrics, shielding foils, custom fabricated magnetic shields, and EMI protection solutions for aerospace, medical, telecommunications, research, defense, and industrial applications.

Why Thermal Expansion Matters in Electronics

A surprising number of electronic failures are caused not by electrical faults, but by thermal expansion mismatch between materials.

As devices heat up and cool down during operation, different materials expand at different rates. Over time, this can lead to:
✔ Cracked solder joints
✔ Delamination of components
✔ Reduced reliability
✔ Premature equipment failure

Choosing the right Thermal Expansion Materials helps improve dimensional stability, thermal management, and long-term performance in:
🔹 Semiconductor Packaging
🔹 Power Electronics
🔹 Aerospace Systems
🔹 Medical Equipment
🔹 EV Battery Systems
🔹 Telecommunications Hardware
